paragraphs: Rabbi Ivo bar Naggara. (See Avin Naggara and Rav Idi bar Avin Naggara.) Rabbah, Va'era, section 9, and Vayeshev, section 85: bar Agri. In Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba’s name, Sotah 10a; Sanhedrin 67b; Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Mo'ed Katan. Both came to Babylonia, Rosh Hashanah 21a. Rashi explains that both were students of Rabbi Yochanan. Ben Pazi (see Rabbi Yehudah ben Pazi), Rabbi Yudan, and Rabbi Ivo in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. Before Rabbi Ila, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name, Shekalim, end of chapter 4. Rabbah, Naso, section 7: Rabbi Ivo b.N. said, etc.; Rabbi Evyatar said, etc.; Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon says, etc. In Rabbi Chuna’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, Sukkah, Lulav va-Aravah, halakhah 3. Before Rabbi, there in Berakhot. Rabbi Tanchum bar Ilai in Rabbi Nachum bar Simai’s name, Ma'aserot, chapter 1.
